title: The lower truncation kernel of a perfect affine lift is finite locally free
statement: Let X = Spec(A) be affine [def-pc-scheme] and let P^\bullet be a bounded-above complex of finite free A-modules [def-pc-perfect-complex] whose restriction to a quasi-compact open U represents a perfect object E of D(\mathcal O_U) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex] of Tor amplitude in [a,b] [lem-pc-affine-tor-amplitude-criterion]. For any r<a, put K = Im(P^{r-1} \to P^r); on U the sheaf \widetilde K|_U coincides with the kernel of \widetilde{P^r}|_U \to \widetilde{P^{r+1}}|_U (the two A-modules Ker(P^r \to P^{r+1}) and Im(P^{r-1} \to P^r) need not agree on X). The restriction to U of the quasi-coherent sheaf \widetilde K associated to K is flat and of finite presentation, hence finite locally free [def-pc-finite-locally-free].
